---
title: "Text Classification"
subtitle: "Supervised text classification with bag-of-words and embeddings."
---

::: {.callout-note title="Where you are in your learning journey" icon=false}
**Where you come from.** You arrive here from [Text as Data](text-as-data.qmd), [Manual Coding](manual-coding.qmd) and [Machine Learning](machine-learning.qmd). You can turn text into data, you have a manually coded set of examples, and you know the basics of machine learning.

**What this module adds.** You'll train a classifier that assigns categories (e.g. topic or sentiment) to texts and evaluate it against your manual coding.

**Why it is valuable.** This lets you analyse thousands of texts with a measurement you can validate, which is the core of modern computational content analysis.
:::
